name: spoond-idle-suspend
request: Quiet sandboxes stay running for an hour before they go to sleep, which holds memory other threads could use; a spoond sandbox wakes on its next use in under a second, so sleeping sooner costs little. Make it 15 minutes. The lease Scout asks spoond for should, by default, have `idle_suspend: 900` (the `idleSuspend` option of SpoondDriver still overrides it), and Scout's own sweep of threads that went quiet should put their sandboxes to sleep after 15 minutes of inactivity rather than an hour.
